# Re-Verse

> Re-Verse is a scripture memory app for [Progress & Perfection](https://progressandperfection.com). Browse a year of weekly verses as flashcards, or spin the Verse Wheel to drill a random one.

Re-Verse is a static, client-rendered site (no build step, no backend). `index.html` is the verse library (flashcards), `verse-wheel/` is the random verse spinner (`index.html` plus `wheel.js`), and `verses.js` holds the verse data consumed by both. Live site: https://re-verse-web.netlify.app/

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sieis/re-verse-web/main/README.md): project overview and usage instructions

## Site

- [Library](https://re-verse-web.netlify.app/): browse verses by theme
- [Verse Wheel](https://re-verse-web.netlify.app/verse-wheel/): spin a wheel to land on a random verse, with true-random and no-repeat modes, a first-five-words hint, add/remove controls for sections and individual verses, and a per-session pick tracker
- [Sitemap](https://re-verse-web.netlify.app/sitemap.xml): list of site pages

## Optional

- [robots.txt](https://re-verse-web.netlify.app/robots.txt): crawler access rules
